answer: Boundary jetty proxies route ingress agent traffic across a validation ridge using ephemeral cipher handshakes. Participating nodes must lock an initial 25,000 POA collateral bond. Detecting forged handshakes or cloned keys triggers 100% bond slashing (50% burned, 50% paid to reporting peers) alongside an 8-epoch ban. An attacker deploying 1,000 fake identities faces 25,000,000 POA in locked bond capital (1,000 x 25,000 POA), whereas honest nodes only deposit 25,000 POA once. A key limitation is network handshake latency during high-congestion epochs.
